runs.summary:
Covers 15 Oct to 15 Nov 2026. One substantial product release in the window, from Braze. Attentive and Canary were quiet on product and active on positioning.

1. Braze Account objects, general availability (new feature). Lets a brand model the business behind its users: companies, franchises, properties, households, with hierarchies between them. This is multi-property data modelling landing natively in a consumer marketing platform, which is the structural advantage hospitality CRM has historically had. Worth watching closely.

2. Braze Skills and External MCP servers (AI/agent). Skills are reusable standing instructions the assistant follows across a workspace. External MCP servers, in early access, let it reach into Jira, Notion and GitHub with per-tool admin approval. The agent layer is becoming an integration surface rather than a chat box.

3. Braze self-serve action banks for Decisioning Studio Pro, beta (AI/agent). Customers can now edit the set of offers, subject lines and send times the decisioning engine chooses from, with the account team reviewing before launch. AI decisioning moving from managed service toward self-serve.

4. Braze WhatsApp Request Contact Info flow, general availability (new feature). Captures a phone number from users who arrive with only a business-scoped WhatsApp ID and links them to an existing profile. Identity resolution for WhatsApp matters for international guest messaging.

5. Attentive's new CEO Eric Miao set out his vision for the company on 9 November (other). The framing is a refounding around AI as the intelligence layer across channels. A leadership change plus a strategy reset usually precedes a roadmap shift, so expect movement here. Attentive also announced Pacsun as a customer on 29 October.

Also in the window: Canary collected the AI and Digital Innovation Impact Award at the Tourism Innovation Summit and an Inc. Power Partner award, both in late October. No product announcements. Braze also shipped a 15 October release that this first pass did not open.
